name: CAREPLS
recent: Careplus 于 2026 年 11 月 25 日召开第 16 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会，股东通过拟议的 1 供 2 可放弃附加股发行。公司于 10 月 27 日发布 2026 年报，并于 11 月 25 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上通过拟议的 1 供 2 可放弃附加股发行，最多发行 425,394,849 股新股。
第 16 届常年股东大会通过所有决议，包括董事费、董事连任、续聘核数师、股份发行授权、关联交易授权更新及股份回购授权更新。
公司发布 2026 年报及截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止财政年的经审核财务报表。
risks: 拟议的附加股发行最多 425,394,849 股新股，占现有股本 50%，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）净亏损 647 万令吉，净亏损率扩大至 22.5%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 2,878.8 万令吉，环比增长 39.4%，同比增长 54.3%；净亏损 647.3 万令吉，净亏损率从上一季度的 9.7% 扩大至 22.5%。

recent_en: Careplus held its 16th AGM and EGM on 25 November 2026, where shareholders approved the proposed 1-for-2 renounceable rights issue. The company released its 2026 annual report on 27 October and announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the proposed 1-for-2 renounceable rights issue of up to 425,394,849 new shares at the EGM.
The company released its 2026 annual report and audited financial statements for the financial year ended 30 June 2026.
risks_en: The proposed rights issue of up to 425,394,849 new shares, representing 50% of existing share capital, may dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
The latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) recorded a net loss of MYR 6.473 million, with net margin widening to -22.5%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 28.788 million, up 39.4% QoQ and 54.3% YoY; net loss was MYR 6.473 million, with net margin widening from -9.7% in the previous quarter to -22.5%.
